In the Pacific, the war ended with the atomic bombings of Hiroshima on August 6 and Nagasaki on August 9, 1945. Following these devastating attacks, Japan accepted surrender on September 2, 1945. This marked the official end of the Pacific Theater as well.

To summarize:
- Europe: May 1944 (Battle of Berlin)
- Pacific: August 1945 (atomic bombings) and September 2, 1945 (surrender)

These events collectively concluded World War II.
